answer: Give every epoch task a hard deadline and record each identity's completion time on-ledger. A fable finished in seconds by a script is not a story told by hand, and a signal that arrives after the deadline is not a response. A relic of genuine work carries its time with it, and a batch of identities that all miss the deadline together marks a farm that queued its fakes. An operator can only finish so many genuine tasks before the clock runs out, so batching fakes means most of them fail.
